name: DotAgents v1.1.8
body:
## Release highlights

DotAgents v1.1.8 focuses on more reliable mobile hands-free control and clearer tool activity.

- Adds an optional manual-send hands-free mode with a configurable send keyword.
- Adds the clear command to discard a pending voice draft without sending it.
- Fixes keyword boundaries so a standalone finalized send or clear segment executes immediately while preserving earlier dictation.
- Improves generic voice-driven agent switching, targeting, session messaging, and recognizer continuity.
- Refines mobile tool-call details and compact tool payload presentation.

## Included assets

- Android APK: DotAgents-1.5.5.apk (Android build 12, main e92a46254)
- SHA-256: 77adc2251ede942d58c508eae5cc360111c1e364d4679672c8bcccb410105389
- The APK uses the same signing certificate as DotAgents 1.5.4 for upgrade compatibility.

Full diff: https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/compare/v1.1.7...v1.1.8

name: DotAgents v1.1.7
body:
## Release highlights

DotAgents v1.1.7 brings a major round of mobile reliability work, richer desktop artifacts, stronger repeat-task controls, and expanded voice integrations.

- More reliable Android hands-free conversations, including wake/pause behavior, audio routing, barge-in, TTS handoff, keyboard handling, and persistent live progress across streaming updates.
- New mobile model controls, push notifications, pairing fixes, clearer tool activity, and better conversation/session rendering.
- New desktop Artifacts experience with responsive previews, authenticated media handling, image copy actions, and improved narrow layouts.
- Discord voice calls and voice replies, with more robust image/media attachment handling and reply filtering.
- Stronger repeat tasks with adversarial critique, clearer run provenance and history, progress hydration, and notification mute controls.
- Refined desktop settings navigation, archived-session controls, remote pairing/reset flows, app chrome, focus behavior, and Codex fast-service settings.
- Improved Codex session bridge support and more durable session/title/progress handling across desktop and mobile.

## Included assets

- Android APK: `DotAgents-1.5.4.apk` (Android build 11, main `1c0c9c9cc`)

The macOS 1.1.7 installers are pending Apple notarization while the developer-team agreement is renewed.

Full diff: https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/compare/v1.1.6...v1.1.7

name: DotAgents v1.1.6
body:
## Release highlights

DotAgents v1.1.6 continues the voice-first push with better release hygiene, cleaner session handling, and tighter mobile/desktop parity.

- More reliable mobile hands-free behavior across pauses, stops, and follow-up turns.
- Better session title provenance and fewer duplicate or empty draft sessions.
- Smarter transcript presentation so truncated content stays visible inline.
- Improved multi-agent TTS coordination and compact chat controls.
- Cleaner packaging with refreshed desktop and Android versioning.

## Included assets

- Android APK: `DotAgents-1.5.0.apk` (Android build 6, main `eb2575959`)
- macOS DMG (Apple Silicon): `DotAgents-1.1.6-arm64.dmg`
- macOS DMG (Intel): `DotAgents-1.1.6-x64.dmg`

Full diff: https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/compare/v1.1.5...v1.1.6

name: DotAgents v1.1.4
body:
## Highlight: Android hands-free voice

This release ships the Android hands-free voice session upgrade. The APK is the main artifact for this release.

- Keeps hands-free listening available through an Android foreground voice service.
- Coordinates locked-screen and background TTS, recognizer state, and global TTS playback.
- Adds state sounds for session ready, prompt submitted, tool calls, agent responses, processing, and compacting/summarizing.
- Supports barge-in commands like "wait" and "stop" to stop agent speech and return to listening.
- Fixes follow-up session continuation, duplicated transcription text, and final response visibility in the mobile transcript.
- Adds mobile hands-free documentation and in-app guide support.
- Tightens mobile message rows so copy/branch controls and agent time stay compact and inline.

## Desktop

Desktop installers are included alongside the Android APK so paired desktop/mobile installs can be updated together.

## Assets

- Android APK: `DotAgents-mobile-1.4.1.apk`
- macOS desktop: Apple Silicon and Intel DMG builds
- Windows desktop: setup installer
- Linux desktop: AppImage and DEB builds

Full changelog: https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/compare/v1.1.3...v1.1.4

name: DotAgents v1.1.3
body:
## What's Changed

- Fixed the desktop production build failure that could stop packaging with `Unterminated string literal` in generated `index.js`.
- Published the `1.1.3` desktop release metadata bump and updated Android release metadata to `versionName=1.4.0`, `versionCode=2`.
- Restored the mobile UI/control refresh from [#477](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/477), including mobile chat controls, settings controls, OAuth/import-export flows, MCP controls, and responsive shell work.
- Improved agent continuation behavior with faster responses, compacted runtime context, preserved compacted conversation context, less status noise, and safer continuation queue routing: [#433](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/433), [#437](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/437), [#438](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/438), [#450](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/450), [#465](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/465).
- Improved desktop session and sidebar behavior, including sidebar lifecycle/hydration fixes, thinking and verbosity pickers, active-session hotkey scoping, panel focus retries, and centralized TTS playback: [#442](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/442), [#444](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/444), [#449](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/449), [#451](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/451), [#455](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/455).
- Improved agent-loop context-read efficiency and realistic replay coverage: [#466](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/466), [#468](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/468).
- Fixed WhatsApp MCP allowlist matching for multi-device JIDs: [#463](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/463).
- Encouraged agents to deliver media inline in chat: [#459](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/459).
- Clarified dev startup docs and removed the bundled DOCX skill: [#439](https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/pull/439).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/aj47/dotagents-mono/compare/v1.1.2...v1.1.3

name: DotAgents v1.1.0
body:
## DotAgents v1.1.0

First minor release since v1.0.2. Focused on repeat tasks, sidebar/tile UX, TTS reliability, MCP context handling, and a Discord integration MVP.

### Highlights

**Repeat tasks**
- Wall-clock schedules (daily/weekly) for repeat tasks
- New `speakOnTrigger` and `continueInSession` flags
- Persist `lastSessionId` + session picker UI
- Auto-refresh repeat tasks on disk changes
- New Tasks section in predefined-prompts menu so you can trigger repeat tasks inline
- `loop-service`: confirms session revival before mutating conversation

**Sidebar / session tiles**
- Agents moved to the settings group; session cards now show runtime tools count and an expanded preview
- `Cmd/Ctrl+N` hint on two-line active session rows
- Session search keyboard shortcuts
- Main session panel now feels full-screen (no more p-3 wrapper / empty top bar)
- Sidebar header doubles as window-drag region on macOS
- Tile footer clicks no longer open the hover panel

**TTS & panel audio**
- Panel `win.on('hide')` is the single source of truth for stopping panel TTS
- ESC closes the floating panel and stops panel TTS without killing main-window TTS
- Prevents the same session being spoken twice when visible in both panel and tile
- Scoped cross-instance autoplay suppression by caller key
- Prevent TTS replay when branching; float play button on compact messages
- Restore `noOpCount` guard before completing on `respond_to_user` when verify is off
- Scoped final-response dedupe to the latest assistant message
- Mobile Edge TTS now routed through paired desktop (not Metro dev proxy)
- Allow mobile `/v1/tts/speak` when desktop `ttsEnabled` is off
- Fix desktop Edge TTS websocket transport

**Agent profiles & chat agent**
- Renamed user profile role to "chat agent"; added agent-setting aliases for legacy MCP tool settings
- Prefer agent profile naming in delegation
- UI migrated to agent setting aliases
- Renamed the agent shortcut display helper

**MCP / tool output**
- Emit Context refs on MCP tool-response summarization
- Preserve original Context ref when summarizing truncated output
- Don't render synthetic tool-failure summaries as standalone bubbles

**.agents**
- Stop auto-writing top-level `~/.agents/system-prompt.md` and `agents.md`
- `agents-folder-watcher`: resolve filenames to `.agents` root + reset flags on stop
- Stop overwriting user-edited files on every save

**Discord integration (MVP)**
- New Discord integration with `/new`, `/whoami`, and per-channel session epoch
- Owner-only mutating slash commands + `/ops` parsed before the normal message gate
- Fail-closed on `/ops` when no operator allowlist is configured
- Exempt application owners from DM allowlist rejection
- Honors `DOTAGENTS_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` fallback; clearing the token while enabled now implicitly stops Discord
- Tiered operator command timeouts by method
- Better logging: every `messageCreate` + gate rejection reasons + interaction handler rejections

**Headless / CLI / onboarding**
- New `dotagents setup` command (CLI stays open after setup)
- Codex OAuth controls added; headless onboarding uses Codex OAuth
- Prevent Codex acpx from inheriting API key env
- Fix ACP text chunk concatenation
- Fix headless CLI ACP follow-up rendering

**Remote server / knowledge / mic**
- Raise Fastify `bodyLimit` to 50 MB for chat requests
- Quick knowledge note promotion to auto context
- Lazy-load knowledge notes by group; default groups collapsed
- Fix microphone selection persistence across restarts
- Preserve conversation history on agent error emit + after emergency stop

**Providers**
- New ChatGPT Web provider; chatgpt provider switched to Codex responses
- New Edge TTS provider options across desktop and mobile
- Replace in-process ACP runtime with `acpx` CLI adapter
- Hide internal response wrappers

**UX / polish**
- Text input fills parent `SessionActionDialog` modal height
- Delegated sidebar session state fix
- Fix TTS autoplay + duplicate responses regressions

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `DotAgents-1.1.0-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `DotAgents-1.1.0-x64.dmg` |

Both DMGs are signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and stapled.

**Verify before install**
```bash
xcrun stapler validate DotAgents-1.1.0-arm64.dmg
# The validate action worked!
```

name: DotAgents v1.0.1
body:
## What's New in v1.0.1

### Desktop

**Session UX overhaul**
- Redesigned session view with adaptive compact cards and auto-organizing grid (#240)
- Conversation branching from any prior message (#264)
- Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 hotkeys to jump between sidebar sessions (#265)
- Session launchers moved into sidebar with pinnable active tiles (#207)
- Sidebar actions collapsed into a clean overflow menu (#203, #204)
- Session timestamps visible by default, not just on hover (#270, #205)
- Fixed sidebar title overlap with timestamps (#274)

**Agent improvements**
- Prompt caching across providers — tracks cache hit/miss metrics, stabilizes system prompts for better cache hits, auto-detects Anthropic via OpenAI-compatible proxies (#278)
- ACP agent profiles now initialize properly during startup (#177)
- Session persistence preserved across desktop restarts (#217)
- Emergency kill switch no longer wipes conversation history (#275)
- `respond_to_user` history no longer lost between turns (#267)
- System prompt now checks knowledge notes before asking redundant questions (#263)

**UI polish**
- Fuzzy search in settings with auto-expand and match highlighting (#268)
- Model picker moved to top of Models page (#276)
- Fixed sidebar status dot colors for active vs idle agents (#246)
- TTS no longer auto-plays when expanding/collapsing session tiles (#247)
- Multiline session input with Shift+Enter (#266)
- Context budget: aggressive tool payload truncation now runs before limit check (#252)

### Mobile

- Lazy-load chat messages for faster large threads (#197)
- Fixed dark-mode session titles (#197)
- Delegation progress now renders as structured chat messages (#198, #245)
- Hands-free: recognizer stays active during processing, added pause/resume control (#200, #198)
- Microphone device selection on web (#271)
- Fixed duplicate conversations from sync (#243)
- Cleaned up raw tool-call text leaking into chat (#188)
- Mobile tool-call rendering fallback for partial responses (#242)

### Build

- Smaller app size — sherpa-onnx voice binaries download on demand instead of shipping bundled
- First Android APK release

---

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `DotAgents-1.0.1-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `DotAgents-1.0.1-x64.dmg` |
| Android | `DotAgents-1.0.1-android.apk` |

macOS builds are signed and notarized.
